name: How does AEO help CPAs attract clients in specific cities like Los Angeles or Chicago?
description: AEO helps CPAs attract local clients by optimizing content to be the authoritative answer for geo-specific queries, linking services to locations for AI search

mainEntity.name: How does AEO help CPAs attract clients in specific cities like Los Angeles or Chicago?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO helps CPAs attract local clients by optimizing content to be the authoritative answer for geo-specific queries. For example, if a user in Los Angeles asks an AI search engine, 'Who is the best CPA for small businesses in Los Angeles?', a firm with strong AEO for local entities and services can be directly suggested. This involves crafting content that explicitly links your services to specific locations, ensuring your firm's name and address are consistently structured, and providing local context within your expertise. This establishes your firm as the relevant, local expert within AI's knowledge base, directly connecting you with local prospects.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO helps CPAs attract local clients by optimizing content to be the authoritative answer for geo-specific queries, linking services to locations for AI search engines.
